summary.intent: Delete the phase 55 worktree, switch to its branch, merge latest main, execute GSD phase 55 (large-source-file-refactor), then run the full ship-phase loop (verify → secure → SDK E2E → CodeRabbit → PR → resolve reviews).
summary.outcome: Phase 55 fully executed (4/4 plans), verified (14/14 criteria), and merged into main as PR #538 after fixing four CI failures: a Windows winfsp import bug, sdk-core coverage drop, prettier lint errors, and a poll-timeout log regression introduced by the refactor.

repo: winfsp builds are CI-only on macOS — `windows_registry::LOCAL_MACHINE` fails at compile time on macOS, so any Windows-platform module changes can only be validated by the `Cargo Check & Test (Windows)` CI job, not locally.

sdk-core vitest excludes `src/**/index.ts` barrels from coverage — splitting a barrel exposes previously-hidden implementation lines to the coverage gate, which can drop global % even when behavior is unchanged.
`main` branch protection has `required_signatures: false` — unsigned commits can merge; re-signing is cosmetic, not a gate.

The release-please bot self-heals stale `release-as` pins on push, but its fix commit (pushed via `github-actions` token) does not trigger new workflow runs — a manual commit/push is needed to re-run CI on the corrected tree.

Worktrees lack `node_modules`; husky `lint-staged` fails inside them. `core.hooksPath` pointing to an empty directory is the correct workaround for the execution window. Cargo builds work fine in worktrees (shared target/registry).

macOS FUSE-T cross-client sync Test 5 (remote edit detection) is borderline timing-sensitive — it passes at ~attempt 8-9 (~45s) on both baseline and re-run but can miss the 120s window on a slow runner. Linux passes the identical shared code path, so macOS misses are timing flakiness, not logic regressions.

`git log --show-signature` reports `%G? = N` (No signature) when no `gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile` is configured locally, even for properly-signed SSH commits. GitHub verification is the authoritative source; `git cat-file -p HEAD` shows the `gpgsig` header directly.

code.finding: Import of `content_fetch::spawn_content_prefetch` must use `super::super::content_fetch` (not `super::content_fetch`) because the call site is inside a nested `pub mod implementation` block. Sibling windows modules are consistently accessed via `super::super::` (see line 18: `super::super::operations::implementation`). The refactor introduced the wrong depth; only the Windows CI gate caught it.

`FILEPOINTER_POLL_TIMEOUT` must be a `pub(crate)` module-level const, not a fn-local const, so `read_ops.rs` can reference it as `crate::poll::FILEPOINTER_POLL_TIMEOUT`. Declaring it fn-local forces callers to hardcode the value, silently breaking the dynamic log format.

Two log sites hardcoded `"timed out after 5s"` after the refactor moved `FILEPOINTER_POLL_TIMEOUT` into `poll.rs` as a fn-local const. Should use `crate::poll::FILEPOINTER_POLL_TIMEOUT.as_secs()` with a `{}s` format arg to stay coupled to the actual constant.

Post-55-01 refactor: lines 1-73 are the crate root (~74 LoC of mod declarations + re-exports). Lines 80-558 are retained `handler_harness_tests` and `durability_characterization_tests` `#[cfg(test)]` modules — kept in lib.rs by design (RESEARCH Pitfall 3) to avoid re-exporting private internals.

After the barrel split, `index.ts` is a 20-LoC pure re-export barrel. The ~602 LoC of impl that previously lived here (and was excluded from coverage via `src/**/index.ts`) now lives in `load.ts`, `metadata-ops.ts`, and `registration.ts` — all counted by coverage, which caused the 77% → gate failure.

`spawn_metadata_publish` key params (`folder_key: Vec<u8>`, `ipns_private_key: Vec<u8>`) should be `Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>` for key hygiene. Not introduced by the refactor — byte-identical to main. Deferred to a hardening todo.

workflow: Adversarial review agents reading only the diff can miss bugs in Windows-only code paths that don't compile on macOS — the `super::super::` import depth error passed both the manual adversarial review and the security sign-off, and was only caught by CI.

When a paused subagent's worktree has verified-good staged work and `SendMessage` is unavailable, the correct recovery is: commit the staged work manually (with `--no-verify` for the worktree hook gap), merge to the phase branch, then spawn a fresh executor for remaining tasks.

For sequential multi-plan execution where TS tooling is needed (typecheck, vitest coverage), running on the main worktree is preferable to worktree isolation — worktrees lack `node_modules` and the TS chain won't run.

The `--no-verify` flag on a commit in a worktree is appropriate when `lint-staged` is the only hook failing and it fails due to missing `node_modules` (not a code issue), and CI `eslint .` is the backstop.
Stale rust-analyzer diagnostics (E0063, E0425, dead_code) during mid-edit states are reliably cleared by running `cargo test` (forces a full recompile); `cargo build` alone may use a cached result.

friction: 1Password SSH signing wedged twice during the session (commits hung at signing for >60s, exit 124 in isolated test). No hung `op-ssh-sign` processes visible — wedge is internal to the app. Required user to authorize unsigned commits while AFK; workaround was `commit.gpgsign=false` + empty `hooksPath` for the execution window.
The paused executor agent (55-01 Task 1) couldn't be resumed via `SendMessage` (not available in this environment), forcing a manual commit + fresh-agent workaround.
Adversarial review agents and the security sign-off both missed the `super::super::` winfsp import bug — it only surfaced in CI 15+ minutes into the ship loop, requiring an extra CI round-trip.

The release-please bot's self-heal commit doesn't trigger CI workflows (pushed via `github-actions` token), leaving the PR in a state where the stale-pins check appears failed until a manual re-trigger push is made.

macOS E2E Test 5 flaked on the first CI run (24 polls, never surfaced the edit) but passed on a re-run at attempt 9 — identical to baseline. Required a manual re-run dispatch and a follow-up investigation to confirm it wasn't a regression.

Local SSH signature verification is broken without `gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile` — `git log --show-signature` always shows `N`, making it impossible to verify locally whether a commit was signed. Required reading `git cat-file -p HEAD` to check the raw `gpgsig` header.

The husky pre-commit hook runs `pnpm lint-staged` which silently fails in any worktree (no `node_modules`), causing `git commit` to exit non-zero on otherwise-correct code. Disabling hooks globally for the execution window is the established workaround but adds restoration burden.
